correctness.rationale: The exact block matrix of the synchronous unweighted open-neighbor update on ordinary subdivision S(G) over every characteristic-2 finite field is F=[[0,B],[B^t,0]], B the unoriented vertex-edge incidence matrix. With L=BB^t=D+A mod 2, F^3=0 iff LB=0; the columns e_u+e_v of B force L_u=L_v along every base edge, hence all columns identical by connectedness. Symmetry plus the unit entry at each base edge forces L=J and G complete, and its diagonals force even order. Conversely even K_n gives L=J and JB=0. F^2 !=0. On even K_n ranks are N, 2(n-1), n-1, 0, and the rank drops establish J3(0)^(n-1) plus J1(0)^(binom(n-2,2)), with exact shell sizes from kernel dimensions. On odd K_n L=I+J and F^3=F, with periodic image W⊕B^t W a swap involution; fixed states q^(n-1), two-cycles (q^(2(n-1))-q^(n-1))/2, one-step basin sizes q^(N-2(n-1)). Rechecked rank and nilpotence for 771 connected labelled simple graphs n<=5 independently; these finite checks do not prove the infinite theorem.

originality.rationale: Other work on nilpotent Boolean graph rules often permits choice of update function and uses existence statements; this theorem prescribes a single adjacency-sum rule on ordinary edge subdivisions, proves rigidity among all connected simple bases, and computes complete parity-sensitive transient and periodic counts. The algebra is short but is not merely a parameter substitution of the referenced existence or minimum-rank theorems. A broader finite-field automata classification could still specialize to it.
